policy.scope: Only guaranteed story stat gains. Optional classroom answers, dozing choices, nurse visits, exam placements and player-chosen activities are excluded.
policy.timing: After the listed daytime slot completes, including locked story slots. Never apply on entering the day or after the evening, and never re-add gains preceding the player's observed starting slot.
policy.slotCost: Part of the already locked daytime story; not an additional action.
policy.wording: 暑期补习 follows the existing Simplified Chinese guide. The gain label is an editorial description, not a claim of verbatim official game UI text.
